units.source_text: 月亮还没有出来，星星的闪光，在周围洒下模糊斑驳的阴影，当然，还无法清晰地分辨远处的山脊线。

en.t: The moon had not yet risen, and the starlight cast blurred, mottled shadows all around; naturally, the distant ridge line still could not be made out clearly.

units.source_text: 怎么老感觉像是朝着海角的前端那一带跑。

en.t: Why did it keep feeling as if he were running toward the tip of the cape?

units.source_text: 我的舵常常有偏左的坏习惯。

en.t: His rudder often had the bad habit of veering to the left.

units.source_text: 他正想改变方向，忽地吃了一惊。

en.t: Just as he was about to change direction, he was suddenly startled.

units.source_text: 原来，自己和追兵的距离竟然在渐渐地缩短。

en.t: It turned out that the distance between him and his pursuers was actually growing shorter little by little.

units.source_text: 他这才注意到了追兵的意图，愕然不止。

en.t: Only then did he notice what his pursuers intended, and he was utterly stunned.
